response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with 13+ years of experience, deep systems thinking, and proven low-latency/high-throughput work (millions of HTTP requests/sec at Sociomantic) plus event-driven platform design. However, the role centers on modern C++/STL development for industrial automation, and his C++ exposure is limited to roughly six months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 and a university thesis — his last decade is almost entirely TypeScript/Node.js, DLang, and web platforms. He also shows no evidence of the required security domain expertise (SDL, IEC 62443), industrial protocols (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA), or Azure. The transferable skills are real, but the core technical stack and domain mismatch is too large for a mid-senior hands-on C++ architecture role.
strengths: Deep experience building high-performance, concurrent, event-driven distributed systems
13+ years across embedded, desktop, backend and web; strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, mentoring)
Proven ownership: founded and maintains an open-source geo-data platform, speaks and teaches publicly
concerns: C++/STL experience is minimal and over a decade stale; primary stack is TypeScript/Node/DLang
No industrial automation, IEC 62443/SDL, or OT protocol (MQTT, Modbus, OPC UA) background
No Azure or cloud-platform-for-industrial experience; no UML/architecture documentation evidence
